verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents a detailed token-usage breakdown per LLM call (docs-46) and can group traces into conversations and user sessions (docs-16, docs-49), with projects (docs-15) and span filtering (docs-30) offering coarse segmentation. Nothing shows custom metadata being used to roll up cost or usage by user, session, or feature. missing for 10: custom metadata/tag attribution on traces, dollar cost calculation, per-user and per-feature cost aggregation or reporting, independent corroboration.
